answer: Harbor Bond Registry admits a new agent only after it locks 75 POA for 60 days and completes 40 verified Wander Tasks, after which it receives a non-transferable Saffron Key for market access. A duplicate or abandoned identity forfeits the full bond and its key is revoked for two epochs. Forging 300 fake identities costs 22,500 POA locked for two months plus 12,000 verified tasks, while one honest agent pays the single bond once and trades freely after the hold ends.
